To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
silica does not constitute a uniform proportion of dust across all particle size ranges and that silica size distributions are similar but not identical to those of dust.
the proportion of silica to total dust varies across different particle sizes and that this variation is important for understanding exposure and developing control strategies.
the size distributions for a given mine dust and its silica components are similar but not the same, and that silica does not make up a uniform proportion of dust across all particle size ranges.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quantification of crystalline silica in respirable mine dust and its relationship to particle size distribution.
the characterization of particle size-specific crystalline silica content in dust generated in mining environments.
characterizing the size-specific silica content of mine dust.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the size distribution of silica in mine dusts is not equivalent to the size distribution of the dust as a whole.
the silica size distributions are similar to the dust size distribution, but are not identical.
the silica content of mine dust is not uniform across all particle sizes, and that the particle size distributions of dust and silica are similar, but not equivalent.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the size distributions for silica are different from the total dust size distributions.
the silica content of a given dust is not constant across all particle sizes, and that the silica content can vary greatly between mine dusts.   1
the size distributions for the silica component are not uniform across particle sizes and that there are similarities and differences between the size distributions for total dust and for silica.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the size-specific silica content of dust is not a constant value, but rather varies across particle sizes.
silica is not homogeneously distributed in dusts and that the size distribution of silica in dust does not necessarily follow that of the total dust.
the size distribution of silica in a given mine dust is not uniform and that the size distribution for a given mine dust and its silica content are similar but not identical.
